evals.name: hook-notice-runs-the-read-only-check
evals.prompt: A hook just said typos-format found no typos binary. Is typos installed here?
evals.expected_output: Reads the setup skill's check section, runs only that check, and reports its PASS/FAIL table for typos. Installs nothing and stops.
expectations: Follows only the `check` section of /typos-format:setup and reports its PASS/FAIL table
Probes typos via Bash rather than assuming it
Does not run `apply`, cargo, a package manager, or any download
Stops after the table instead of continuing into remediation

evals.name: install-request-is-routed-not-performed
evals.prompt:
/typos-format:check

The check failed. Just install typos for me.
evals.expected_output: Does not install from this skill. Names /typos-format:setup apply as the successor for an explicit install request.
expectations: Names /typos-format:setup apply as the route for the install the user asked for
Does not claim typos is now installed

evals.name: passing-check-has-no-successor
evals.expected_output: When typos resolves, reports PASS and stops without suggesting setup apply.
expectations: Reports the PASS/FAIL table from the check section
On a PASS, does not suggest /typos-format:setup apply

evals.name: disabled-plugin-downgrades-missing-typos-to-info
evals.prompt:
/typos-format:check

typos is missing, and typos_format_enabled is false in this repo.
evals.expected_output: Reports the missing typos as INFO, not FAIL, because the hook exits through its enabled-gate before probing, and installs nothing.
expectations: Treats the missing typos as INFO because the plugin is disabled
Notes that re-enabling the plugin restores the FAIL semantics
Installs nothing and stops after the table

evals.name: check-runs-its-own-probes-including-node
evals.prompt:
/typos-format:check

node is not on PATH here, though typos is installed.
evals.expected_output: Runs the jq, node and typos probes via Bash, since setup's pre-computed rows are not rendered when this skill reads the file, and reports a Node.js FAIL with the reason.
expectations: Runs the jq, node and typos probes via Bash instead of expecting pre-computed rows
Reports the missing node as FAIL because every hook launch goes through node hooks/exec-bash.mjs
Installs nothing and stops after the table
